lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Left end tab (patches 2/5), a 90.2 deg fold. In the 25/50/75% sections the outermost point at the line sits 0.00-0.02 mm from the outer skin, so the line is on the outer apex. It runs parallel to the fold axis. The fold's visible extent along the axis is S -0.59..5.45 mm, edge rounding included, and the line covers 5.12 mm of it (about 85%). Looking along the bisector, the line covers about 87% of the tab width.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Right end tab (patches 2/4), a 90.5 deg fold. In the sections the apex is 0.01-0.02 mm from the outer skin. The line is parallel to the fold axis. The fold's extent is S -0.37..5.76 mm and the line covers 5.31 mm of it (about 87%). B2 is collinear with B1 but folds a different, unconnected tab. About 48 mm of flat bar lies between them: measured off the base plane it stays within -1.49..+0.05 mm, which is just the sheet thickness. So these are 2 separate bends, not one fold interrupted by a relief.
